records.instruction: Mark everything in my Gmail inbox and outbox in the current calendar month as unread.

Buy the highest rated popcorn maker available on Amazon now, one for each of my following friends, Grant , Jose , Brenda , Nicholas. They have to be gift wrapped and delivered to their respective home addresses. If the total delivery fee is higher than the monthly prime subscription cost, subscribe me to prime first.

My manager assigns me tasks at the beginning of every week with a subject starting with "To Do". At the end of each week, I reply to them "Completed." or "Not Completed.". For this week, I have starred the emails/tasks which I finished working on, and left the others unstarred. I am closing off this week now, please reply accordingly, and unstar those threads. I may have non-todo emails starred, please keep them as is.

records.instruction: Place an amazon order for 1 quantity of 'Ascend Ultralight Hammock', 3 quantity of 'The Complete Mediterranean Cookbook' and 3 quantity of 'Athleta Studio Wrap', and have it delivered to my home. Use HSBC payment card if it's already in my account, otherwise use what I have in it. Also, I have important things in my cart, so revert its state to as it is now after the order.

I get monthly internet bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "internet | MM/YYYY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YYYY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's internet usage.

assert all added expenses have group_id matching private_data.group_id.
assert all added expenses have payer_id of private_data.splitwise_user_id.
